Route1_Text_WorkAtPokeMartTakeSample:
Hi! I work at a POKéMON MART.
It's part of a convenient chain selling all sorts of items.
Please, visit us in VIRIDIAN CITY.
I know, I'll give you a sample. Here you go!
Route1_Text_ComeSeeUsIfYouNeedPokeBalls: Please come see us if you need POKé BALLS for catching POKéMON.
Route1_Text_PutPotionAway: {PLAYER} put the POTION away in the BAG's ITEMS POCKET.
Route1_Text_CanJumpFromLedges:
See those ledges along the road?
It's a bit scary, but you can jump from them.
You can get back to PALLET TOWN quicker that way.
